title: TrustIoT chart values
description: Validated by helm lint, template and install. README.md documents every field.

deploymentMode.description: Deployment shape, set by values-saas.yaml or values-onprem.yaml.

hosts.description: Our own domain names, never IP addresses (portability rule 1).

authzProvider.description: Name of the istiod meshConfig extension provider that calls the identity service.

allowedSources.description: IPv4 CIDRs allowed to reach the ingress pods in tunnel mode; never the whole network.

clusterIP.description: Fixed ClusterIP of the ingress gateway Service in tunnel mode: empty, or one IPv4 address from the static band of the cluster's Service range. The templates refuse it with direct exposure.

publicPaths.description: The only cookie-free paths (decision 27): exact paths, no wildcards.

env.description: Every service gets serviceDefaults.env, so it must not read Secrets.

services.description: TrustIoT services keyed by name; each entry overrides serviceDefaults.

calls.description: Who may call whom: <caller>: [<callee>, ...], both keys under services. A call between two services (other than ai-gateway) may also carry the user of the request, through the identity service's token exchange.

internalIdentity.description: Internal identity tokens (decision 27): the identity service's Ed25519 keys are generated in the cluster by its init container and rotated by age by a CronJob (docs/architecture/secrets.md); these settings ask for a rotation or a revocation, set the maximum key age, and move over a key a person made before Laysi/trustiot-v2#404.

keyGeneration.description: Increase it to rotate the signing key; at least 1 and at least revokeBeforeGeneration. Only goes up.

revokeBeforeGeneration.description: Keys of a lower generation are removed at once (a leaked key); 0 revokes nothing.

keyPropagationSeconds.description: How long a new public key is published before its key signs: more than every pod needs to see a ConfigMap change.

maxKeyAgeSeconds.description: Rotation by key age (Laysi/trustiot-v2#429): once the signing key was published this many seconds ago, the CronJob <release>-identity-key-rotation rotates it like a manual rotation. 0 turns it off; otherwise at least 2 * keyPropagationSeconds + 305 (checked when the chart renders) and at most 365 days.

keyRotationSchedule.description: When the rotation CronJob checks the key's age, in Etc/UTC (no TZ= prefix): @daily, @midnight, @hourly, or five cron fields whose day of month, month and day of week are *, so it runs every day. The identity service logs an ERROR when its key is two days past its rotation, and the key may only outlive maxKeyAgeSeconds by the time to the next run.

publicKeys.description: Before Laysi/trustiot-v2#404 only, with signingKeySecret: the Ed25519 public keys as {kid, x}, where the init container finds the key id of the key it imports. Only these two members, so a private key (d) cannot be listed.

kid.description: Key id: 1 to 64 visible ASCII characters.

x.description: The 32-byte public key in base64url without padding (43 characters, canonical).

signingKeySecret.description: Before Laysi/trustiot-v2#404 only: the Secret a person made with the identity service's PKCS#8 private key, mounted into its init container only, which imports the key once.

certificateAuthority.description: Gateway certificate authority (decision 12, Laysi/trustiot-v2#78): the issuing CA keys are generated in the cluster by the certs pod's init container; an operator signs their requests with the offline root (services/certs/README.md). Certificates only, as one-line base64 DER: never a private key.

keyGeneration.description: Increase it to add an issuing CA key; at least 1 and at least removeKeysBeforeGeneration. Only goes up.

removeKeysBeforeGeneration.description: Keys of a lower generation are removed at the next certs pod start (a leaked or retired key); 0 removes nothing.

rootCertificate.description: The offline root CA certificate's DER in base64 on one line; empty until the root ceremony.

issuingCertificates.description: The issuing CA certificates the root signed, each its DER in base64 on one line.

rootCrl.description: The root CRL's DER in base64 on one line (the body of its PEM X509 CRL); empty until a root ceremony signs one. The chart checks that it starts like a v2 CRL; the certs service checks the root's signature.

migrate.description: The migration Job (tools/migrate, Laysi/trustiot-v2#60) and the init container that holds every service until it has completed.

revision.description: Change it to run the Job again, for example after a password Secret lost its data.

passwordGeneration.description: Increase it to rotate every password the Job generates (service login roles, the collector's ClickHouse account).

parameters.description: PostgreSQL memory and connection sizing only; TLS and authentication settings are the chart's and CloudNativePG's.

operator.description: Where the CloudNativePG operator runs; the Postgres NetworkPolicy admits its status checks.

adminUser.description: Bootstrap account with access management, used only by the migration Job.

adminPasswordGeneration.description: Increase it to rotate the generated admin password: ClickHouse restarts and its init container generates a new one first.

adminSecret.description: Only for installations from before Laysi/trustiot-v2#403: an existing Secret with the admin password. Empty name: the password is generated in the cluster.

adminSecretRevision.description: With adminSecret only: change after rotating that Secret; restarts ClickHouse so it reads the new password.

mqttBroker.description: MQTT broker (Mosquitto, Laysi/trustiot-v2#84), inside the cluster only.

passwordGeneration.description: Increase it to rotate the services' broker passwords: the broker restarts and its init container generates new ones first.

trustInterval.description: How often the trust sidecar fetches the CA certificates and CRLs and checks the server certificate.

certificateGeneration.description: Increase it to renew the broker's server certificate, with a new key, at the certificate CronJob's next run; at least 1. Only goes up.

certificateSchedule.description: When the certificate CronJob runs, in Etc/UTC (no TZ= prefix): @hourly, or five cron fields whose minute is a comma-separated list of *, */<step> (1 to 59) or minutes from 0 to 59, and whose hour, day of month, month and day of week are *, so it runs at least every hour and the API server accepts it. No ranges. templates/_mqtt-broker.tpl checks the same.

from.description: Single line only, so it cannot inject mail headers.

ai.description: The AI gateway's providers, model roles and time budget (services/ai-gateway).

requestTimeout.description: The gateway's http.request_timeout: more than 0 and at most one hour, in ms, s, m or h.

collector.description: OpenTelemetry collector (decision 22): redacts and writes logs and traces to ClickHouse, optionally forwards them to a SIEM.

user.description: Account created by the migration Job with the trustiot_otel_collector role.

name.description: HTTP header name; its whole value comes from the Secret.

allOf.description: On-prem never goes through Cloudflare: the ingress gateway faces the customer network (decision 27).
SaaS reaches every external endpoint over the internet, so they must use https.

dnsName.description: Lower-case DNS name with at least two labels; the last label starts with a letter, so IP addresses are rejected.

optionalHostOrIp.description: Empty, a lower-case DNS name or an IPv4 address.

optionalHttpUrl.description: Empty or an http(s) URL without user info, so credentials never sit in values.

optionalHttpsUrl.description: Empty or an https URL without user info.

hostCidr.description: IPv4 CIDR with a prefix of at least /8.

optionalIpv4Address.description: Empty or one IPv4 address: four decimal octets without leading zeros, so no CIDR, no 'None' and no IPv6 (the pattern of trustiot.ingress.ipv4Pattern).

exactPath.description: One exact lower-case path: segments start with a letter or digit, so no '.', '..', '//', trailing '/', '%', ';' or wildcards; never under /internal (decision 27).

routePath.description: '/' or a lower-case path in the exactPath form; never under /internal (decision 27).

k8sName.description: DNS-1123 subdomain, the format of Kubernetes object names.

secretKeyRef.description: Reference to one key of an existing Secret; an empty name means not configured.

credentialsSecret.description: Username and password in one existing Secret; an empty name means not configured.

waitDuration.description: A duration in whole seconds, minutes or hours, at most one hour (the Job refuses longer waits).

baseUrl.description: Empty (the provider's own API) or an https URL with a host name and no user info, query or fragment; the gateway sends the key there.

aiDuration.description: A duration with one unit, such as 30s, 500ms, 10m or 1h.

aiRole.description: A model role of the AI gateway: its models in fallback order and the limits of a call (services/ai-gateway/README.md).

models.description: <provider>/<model id>, the first choice first; the id is printable ASCII without spaces or commas.

postgresMemory.description: A PostgreSQL memory setting with its unit, for example 128MB.

probe.description: A Kubernetes probe object; {} disables an optional probe.

envVar.description: Kubernetes EnvVar with either a literal value or exactly one valueFrom source.

not.description: Names starting with TRUSTIOT_ plus a letter or digit, SENTRY_ or OTEL_ are set by the chart.

then.description: Secret-like variables must come from a Secret: valueFrom.secretKeyRef only, never a literal value or another source.

healthPort.description: Container port named health where the service serves /healthz and /readyz only; the probes use it and the Service does not expose it.

credentials.description: Dependency Secrets injected into this service only; never set in serviceDefaults.

database.description: Postgres settings of a service that lists postgres under mesh.calls; never set in serviceDefaults.

maxConnections.description: Size of the service's main pool (TRUSTIOT__DATABASE__MAX_CONNECTIONS, AI_GATEWAY__DATABASE__MAX_CONNECTIONS for ai-gateway); the chart checks the service's own range and the sum against postgres.bundled.parameters.max_connections.

podLabels.description: app.kubernetes.io/ and helm.sh/ keys and istio.io/dataplane-mode are reserved for the chart's own labels.

podAnnotations.description: checksum/ keys are reserved for the chart; legacy AppArmor and seccomp annotations are rejected (use the security contexts).

seLinuxOptions.description: Only the SELinux types and fields that the restricted Pod Security Standard allows.

podSecurityContext.description: Allow-list of pod security settings within the restricted Pod Security Standard.

containerSecurityContext.description: Allow-list of container security settings within the restricted Pod Security Standard.
